sections.content: This report provides an overview of sales performance for the current quarter.

sections.query: SELECT region, SUM(sales_amount) as total_sales, COUNT(*) as num_orders FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_sales DESC
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) as month, SUM(sales_amount) as total FROM sales WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
sections.title: Sales Trend - Last 12 Months
sections.caption: Monthly sales performance over the past year

sections.query: SELECT product_name, SUM(quantity) as total_qty FROM sales GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 10
sections.title: Top 10 Products by Quantity Sold
sections.caption: Best-selling products by quantity

sections.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as customer_count FROM sales WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
sections.template: In the last 30 days, we served {customer_count} unique customers.
